  "situation": "The Intelligence Community must settle the SS-8’s estimated payload capacity in a forthcoming strategic weapons estimate. A July 1962 estimate found the information inadequate to determine whether the missile was larger than the SS-6 or smaller than the SS-7. By early 1963, assessments ranged from a small missile with a payload of about 3,500 pounds to a large one with a payload of about 17,500 pounds. A panel of civilian scientists assessed that the SS-8 was probably not as large as the Air Force proposed and cited indications of a payload of 4,000–5,000 pounds. An advisory panel to the DCI concurred in a small-missile assessment, and the Army had also reached that view.
